# smc_outbound_multilink (Resource)

This represents an Outbound Multi-Link, which is used for load balancing outbound traffic by combining multiple NetLinks. It includes attributes for link selection method, timeout, maximum retries, and lists of Multi-Link Members and QoS Classes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `comment` (String) An optional comment for the element. This field is not required.
- `id` (String) this attribute is the identifier of terraform resource
- `location_ref` (String) This represents the definition of a Location, which keeps a list of Network Elements belonging to the same location.
- `multilink_member` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--multilink_member))
- `multilink_method` (String) The method for link selection in the Outbound Multi-Link. Options are 'rtt' for Round Trip Time or 'ratio' for Ratio-based distribution.
- `multilink_qos_class` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--multilink_qos_class))
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `retries` (Number) The maximum number of retries for checking each NetLink in the Outbound Multi-Link.
- `timeout` (Number) The timeout in seconds for measuring NetLink performance in the Outbound Multi-Link.

### Read-Only

- `admin_domain` (String) This represents a Domain. Domains are administrative boundaries that allow you to separate the configuration details and other information in the system for the purpose of limiting administrator access.
- `etag` (String) The ETag of the element, used for versioning. This field is not required.
- `key` (Number) The unique identifier for the element. This field is required for updates but not for creation.
- `link` (Map of String) provides additional actions or resources.
- `locked` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is locked. This field is not required.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is read-only. This field is not required.
- `system` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is a System element. This field is not required.
- `system_key` (Number) The system key of the System element. This field is not required.
- `trashed` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is trashed. This field is not required.

<a id="nestedblock--multilink_member"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multilink_member`

Optional:

- `ip_range` (String) The IP address range for dynamic source address translation (NAT) for the internal source IP addresses on this NetLink. Required when static NetLink is used.
- `netlink_ref` (String) This represents a NetLink, which is used for implementing routing of Multi-Link features. NetLinks can represent any IP-based network links (such as ISP routers, xDSL, leased lines, dial-up modems). NetLinks are combined together into an Outbound Multi-link.
- `netlink_role` (String) The role of the NetLink in the Outbound Multi-Link configuration, either 'active' or 'standby'.
- `network_ref` (String) This represents a Network, which is a Network Element that represents a (sub)network of computers. It includes attributes for IPv4 and IPv6 networks, broadcast address, and validation patterns.
- `qos_role` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--multilink_member--qos_role))

<a id="nestedblock--multilink_member--qos_role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multilink_member.qos_role`

Optional:

- `netlink_role` (String) The role for NetLink usage, which defines the specific role associated with the QoS Class.
- `qos_class_ref` (String) This represents a QoS Class, which is an element that links a rule in a QoS Policy to one or more Firewall Actions. The traffic allowed in the access rule is assigned the QoS Class defined for the rule, and the QoS class is used as the matching criteria for applying QoS Policy rules.



<a id="nestedblock--multilink_qos_class"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multilink_qos_class`

Optional:

- `balance_method` (String) The method used for load balancing in the Multi-Link QOS Class, which can be 'notdefined', 'ratio', or 'rtt'.
- `key` (Number) The unique key for this Multi-Link QOS Class Member, used for updates. For internal use only.
- `qos_class_ref` (String) This represents a QoS Class, which is an element that links a rule in a QoS Policy to one or more Firewall Actions. The traffic allowed in the access rule is assigned the QoS Class defined for the rule, and the QoS class is used as the matching criteria for applying QoS Policy rules.
